change_summary: Add sliding-window trimming in build_messages to keep only the last ≈1500 tokens of history.
reason_for_change: Long conversations (#20, #54, #99) sent ever-growing histories; by discarding distant turns we shrink prompts ~5-15 % with no accuracy loss because recent context suffices, directly lowering mean token cost per task.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — invalid run: 3 task(s) crashed in the harness (harness_error) — the change breaks the harness
hypothesis: Implement a safe, token-budget sliding window that keeps the last ~1500 tokens of history (excluding system) and discards older turns, avoiding the crash that previously failed by ensuring we never drop required role fields.
